title: Quiet Commute — Sage Transit PSA
description: A vertical 2:3 subway OOH poster for mental-health nonprofits: one calm illustrated figure, a single humanist sentence, and an oversized accessible hotline number against a muted sage ground. Differs from attention-grab ad-banners by prioritising stillness and legibility over visual noise.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment a tired commuter looks up and needs to feel seen. It refuses urgency, clutter, and brand showmanship — everything a mental-health PSA must not do. Every element earns its place: the figure offers quiet company, the sentence speaks plainly, and the hotline number is impossible to miss. It is designed for transit environments where trust must be established in under three seconds with no second chance.
goodFor: Subway and metro OOH digital screen campaigns
Nonprofit public-service print or digital single-message drops
Community outreach slides where one clear message must land fast
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly reviews requiring dense data layout
Multi-product promotional banners with competing CTAs
Conference keynote decks built around speaker branding
E-commerce ad units demanding strong retail urgency and price callouts
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a held breath inside a crowded transit car — one calm, simply drawn figure floats in ample negative space against a muted earthy ground, offering quiet companionship rather than confrontation. Three unhurried zones stack vertically: the figure above, a plain-spoken sentence in the middle, and an unmissable number below, each given room to land without competing. The overall mood is still, trustworthy, and immediately human. Avoid texture collisions, decorative layering, or any visual energy that reads as promotional or urgent.
examples.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <!-- Muted earthy ground -->
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#ece8df"/>

  <!-- Soft vertical poster framing (subtle, same-tone) -->
  <rect x="600" y="0" width="720" height="1080" fill="#ece8df"/>
  <line x1="600" y1="0" x2="600" y2="1080" stroke="#7a8580" stroke-width="0.75" opacity="0.25"/>
  <line x1="1320" y1="0" x2="1320" y2="1080" stroke="#7a8580" stroke-width="0.75" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- ===== FIGURE ZONE (upper 60%) ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Ambient aura — a held-breath halo -->
    <circle cx="960" cy="320" r="230" fill="#a3b59a" opacity="0.14"/>
    <circle cx="960" cy="320" r="160" fill="#a3b59a" opacity="0.18"/>

    <!-- Body: calm, shoulders softly rounded, seated posture -->
    <path d="M 830 560
             Q 800 470 820 380
             Q 845 315 900 300
             L 1020 300
             Q 1075 315 1100 380
             Q 1120 470 1090 560
             Z"
          fill="#a3b59a"/>

    <!-- Subtle inner fold — a quiet gesture, hands in lap -->
    <path d="M 885 555 Q 960 500 1035 555"
          fill="none" stroke="#2d3e3a" stroke-width="2.2" opacity="0.55" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Collar line suggesting relaxed shoulders -->
    <path d="M 895 330 Q 960 355 1025 330"
          fill="none" stroke="#2d3e3a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.45" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M 935 298 L 935 268 Q 960 258 985 268 L 985 298 Z"
          fill="#a3b59a"/>

    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="960" cy="215" r="62" fill="#a3b59a"/>

    <!-- The gentlest facial suggestion: closed, calm -->
    <path d="M 938 222 Q 945 218 952 222" fill="none" stroke="#2d3e3a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M 968 222 Q 975 218 982 222" fill="none" stroke="#2d3e3a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== SENTENCE ZONE (middle band) ===== -->
  <g font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif" fill="#2d3e3a">
    <text x="658" y="712" font-size="34" font-style="italic" letter-spacing="0.3">Whatever you're carrying</text>
    <text x="658" y="758" font-size="34" font-style="italic" letter-spacing="0.3">today, you do not have</text>
    <text x="658" y="804" font-size="34" font-style="italic" letter-spacing="0.3">to carry it alone.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Thin divider — a held pause between the sentence and the number -->
  <line x1="658" y1="848" x2="720" y2="848" stroke="#2d3e3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ===== HOTLINE ZONE (bottom) ===== -->
  <text x="658" y="1010"
        font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
        font-size="230" font-weight="700"
        fill="#2d3e3a" letter-spacing="6">988</text>

  <!-- Supporting label -->
  <text x="658" y="1048"
        font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
        font-size="16" fill="#7a8580" letter-spacing="5">CALL  ·  TEXT  ·  ANY HOUR  ·  FREE & CONFIDENTIAL</text>

  <!-- Tiny PSA mark (identity without showmanship) -->
  <text x="1262" y="1048" text-anchor="end"
        font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
        font-size="13" fill="#7a8580" letter-spacing="4">A PUBLIC SERVICE MESSAGE</text>
</svg>
examples.layoutNotes: Vertical 2:3 canvas divided into three stacked zones with an 8% outer margin on all sides: the illustrated figure occupies the upper 60% of the canvas, centered horizontally with generous surrounding negative space; the single PSA sentence sits in the middle band, left-aligned; the oversized hotline number anchors the bottom zone, spanning the full text-column width to maximise legibility. No header band, no logo strip — the muted ground color and the figure alone carry identity. Hierarchy is established entirely through scale contrast between the sentence and the number below it.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a held breath — unhurried and warm, the way a quiet corner of a loud transit platform can feel like shelter. A softly rendered illustrated figure offers quiet company without demanding attention, floating in generous negative space against a muted, earthy ground. The single sentence below it speaks plainly and directly, almost conversational in register, while the hotline number rests at the bottom like a door left open. Avoid decorative flourish, visual tension, or any element that competes for attention — the entire composition should signal that it is safe to pause here.

examples.layoutNotes: Vertical 2:3 canvas with a 7% outer margin on all four sides and no header or footer band. Illustrated figure occupies the upper 55% of the canvas, centered horizontally, surrounded by deliberate negative space — no crop, no bleed. A single short sentence sits in the middle band, left-aligned within a centered text column spanning cols 2–5 of a 6-col grid, separated from the figure by an airy gap. The oversized hotline number anchors the bottom quarter, centered, and is treated as the single heaviest typographic element on the entire surface — larger than every other text element.
